text: 盘前必读丨证监会释放稳市信号；北京将布局建设Token工厂 机构认为，市场信心有望持续修复，A股长期稳健发展、价值投资主导的运行大趋势不变。
text_en: Pre-market must-read: CSRC sends stability signals; Beijing to plan Token factory construction; institutions believe market confidence may steadily recover, with A-shares' long-term healthy development and value-investing trend unchanged
